verdict.rationale: Salv is a compliance SaaS platform, so a natural-language command interface is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only a REST API, webhooks and UI-driven configuration. The one AI feature, AI-Powered Insights, explains name-match adjudication for information only and is not a way to operate the product through natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
